Part 2 (episodes 8 to 15) arrives on Prime Video in 2027.


If you love the series and want more than rewatching while the rest of Helluva Boss Season 3 rolls out, **interacting with the game version of the cast** is a great option.[Redbean](https://www.redbean.ai/) is a playground for Helluva Boss fans where you recreate Stolas, Blitzø or your own OC ( *imp, hellhound, Goetia…* ) as playable characters, talk to them in character and rewrite the plot or the ending you wanted. This guide covers the release schedule, the new cast and lore, and what to do while you wait for Part 2.

##


**Where to Watch Helluva Boss Season 3**


#


Helluva Boss started as an independent YouTube series in 2020 and moved to Prime Video with Season 3. That split is why the answer to where to watch Helluva Boss depends on which season you want and how long you can wait.


###


**On Prime Video (Uncensored, Available Now)**


#


Helluva Boss Season 3 (all 7 episodes of Part 1) aired on[Amazon Prime Video](https://www.primevideo.com/detail/0GEB35CUYRCDVXUV0UXQY9FHIF) from October 14 to October 28, 2026. The series is available in more than 240 countries and territories (not available in China, Russia and a few other countries).


As Season 3 is exclusive premium content, you can either join a paid tier (in the US, Amazon Prime at $14.99 a month or standalone Prime Video at $8.99 a month. Prices can vary by country) or access Prime through official free trials:


- **30-Day Free Trial:** new Amazon Prime members get 30 days free, enough to watch all of Part 1.
- **Student 6-Month Free Trial:** Prime for Young Adults is free for 6 months, then $7.49 a month.
- **Mobile Carrier / ISP Bundles:** some phone and broadband plans include Prime Video, such as Jio, Vi and Airtel broadband in India.


###


**Watch Helluva Boss Season 3 Without Prime (Free)**


#


You can watch Helluva Boss Season 3 without Prime by waiting for the official YouTube release. Each Season 3 episode lands on[VivziePop’s YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL-uopgYBi65HwiiDR9Y23lomAkGr9mm-S) about 45 days after its Prime Video premiere, so episodes 1 to 3 arrive on November 28, episodes 4 and 5 on December 5, and episodes 6 and 7 on December 12, 2026.


The YouTube versions are free with ads but edited to fit YouTube’s content rules, and VivziePop has described Season 3 as the series’ most explicit season so far. Fans who want the full cut will need Prime Video. Any other site offering Helluva Boss Season 3 online free before those dates is **not** an official source, so YouTube and Prime Video are the only platforms to watch the show legally.


###


**Where to Watch Helluva Boss Seasons 1, 2 and the Pilot**


#


Seasons 1 and 2 (20 episodes) plus the original pilot remain free on VivziePop’s YouTube channel. Prime Video carries uncensored versions of both seasons and “Mission: Zero,” a remake of the pilot. If you are new to the show, start with the pilot on YouTube, then Season 1, before jumping into Season 3.

##


**What Is the Plot of Helluva Boss Season 3?**


#


Helluva Boss is an adult animated musical series about Blitzø and I.M.P. (Immediate Murder Professionals), a small imp-run company that kills humans on Earth for clients in Hell. Season 3 starts with Stolas stripped of his powers and working alongside the crew. The missions continue, but the real stakes are personal: Blitzø and Stolas are unsure where they stand, Millie and Moxxie prepare for a major life change, and Loona takes on a bigger role at the company. Old enemies come back, and the crew runs into problems their weapons cannot solve.


VivziePop has said the season was written as one 15-episode arc, so Season 3 Part 1 ends as a midpoint rather than a cliffhanger.

##


**How Season 3 Changes Characters and Relationship Lore**


#


**Spoiler warning:** this section covers plot and events through Season 3 Part 1.


###


**Blitzø and Stolas**


#


The central relationship of the series pulls apart on purpose this season. After “A Trial of Errors,” the two make peace, but VivziePop has explained that both need to heal from their own trauma first. By the finale, Blitzø wishes Stolas happiness instead of trying to win him back.


###


**Stolas, Vassago and Octavia**


#


“The Auction” reunites Stolas with Vassago, his youthful crush, who buys back Stolas’s mother’s necklace for him. In “YES/NO,” Vassago becomes Octavia’s magic tutor, and a museum trip finally reconciles father and daughter. Stolas ends Part 1 dating Vassago.


###


**Millie, Moxxie and Loona**


#


Millie’s pregnancy shapes her arc, which animation director Mel Mrozek describes as Millie finding herself, and her clash with Cassity in “Bad Reputation” brings her past into the open. Moxxie spends the season trying to stay calm as a father-to-be. Loona gets her first real arc in the series as she moves from the front desk into field work.


###


**Barbie Wire and Striker**


#


Barbie asks Blitzø for work in “YES/NO,” while Striker follows Blitzø to Earth for revenge, angry that Blitzø became the face of the imp uprising Striker wanted to lead. Striker fails, then leaves with Barbie as her new partner.


##


**Helluva Boss Season 3 Part 2: Release Date and Theories**


#


Part 2 brings the last eight episodes (8 to 15) to Prime Video in 2027, with no exact date announced as of November 2026. If you are planning where to watch Helluva Boss Season 3 Part 2, expect the same Prime-first, YouTube-later rollout. These are the fan theories that come up most in discussions on the Helluva Boss fan communities:


- **Striker leads an imp uprising:** with Barbie Wire beside him, Striker rallies imps against Blitzø, and fans expect it to go badly once Satan responds.
- **Andrealphus targets Octavia:** fans predict Andrealphus will try to arrange a royal marriage for Octavia to control the Goetia bloodline, but she can refuse. This may push him toward more dangerous moves against her.
- **Stolas, Octavia and Vassago:** with Vassago now both Stolas’s partner and Octavia’s tutor, fans expect the new family dynamic to be tested. One theory has Octavia confronting Blitzø, holding him responsible for her father’s safety.
- **Loona’s injury changes I.M.P.:** after her near-fatal wound, fans expect Blitzø to become overprotective and try to keep Loona off missions.
- **Stella gets her own episode:** a popular theory says Part 2 will show Stella’s side of the story, recasting her as a tragic villain shaped by Andrealphus rather than a simple antagonist.


The Hazbin Hotel crossover also grows in Part 2. Both shows share one setting, the **Hellaverse** , and the Seven Deadly Sins and Vassago link the two. Fans have paired the casts in art, fanfic and crossover AUs for years, and Part 1 already hides visual nods to Hazbin Hotel.[A small but direct crossover with the Hazbin Hotel cast](https://screenrant.com/hazbin-hotel-helluva-boss-crossover-brandon-rogers-response/) is confirmed for Part 2, more than a cameo but brief. Season 4 will then be the final season of Helluva Boss.

**FAQ**


#


###


**Where can I watch Helluva Boss Season 3? Is the show on Netflix?**


#


No, Helluva Boss is not on Netflix. Season 3 streams exclusively on Prime Video, which also carries uncensored Seasons 1 and 2 and the “Mission: Zero” pilot. If you’re looking for where to watch Helluva Boss all three seasons, visit the official VivziePop’s YouTube channel (with Season 3 episodes reaching YouTube from November 28 to December 12, 2026).


###


**When is Helluva Boss Season 3 coming out on YouTube?**


#


Season 3 Part 1 comes out on VivziePop’s YouTube channel in three batches: episodes 1 to 3 on November 28, episodes 4 and 5 on December 5, and episodes 6 and 7 on December 12, 2026. These free uploads, about 45 days after each Prime Video premiere, are the official way to watch Helluva Boss Season 3 online free.


###


**When does Helluva Boss Season 3 Part 2 release?**


#


Part 2 is scheduled for 2027 on Prime Video, with no exact date announced as of November 2026. It contains the remaining eight episodes of Season 3 (8 to 15), and each episode should reach YouTube about 45 days after it premieres on Prime Video.


###


**Who is the main villain of Helluva Boss Season 3?**


#


Helluva Boss Season 3 has no single main villain. Stella and Andrealphus target Stolas through the Goetia court, Cassity confronts Millie in the Wrath Ring, and Striker attacks Blitzø in the Part 1 finale “YES/NO,” then teams up with Barbie Wire, which makes Striker the most likely central threat in Part 2.


###


**Who is Vassago in Helluva Boss?**


#


Vassago is a Goetic prince and Stolas’s youthful crush, voiced by Harvey Guillén. He first appeared in the Hazbin Hotel pilot and joined Helluva Boss in “Mastermind.” In Season 3, Vassago reconnects with Stolas in “The Auction,” becomes Octavia’s magic tutor and is dating Stolas by the end of Part 1.


###


**Does Loona die in Helluva Boss Season 3?**


#


**No** , Loona does not die in Season 3 Part 1 of Helluva Boss. She is badly wounded in episode 6, “Return to Loo Loo Land,” and sits out the Part 1 finale while recovering, but she survives, and the Hellaverse Wiki still lists her status as active heading into Part 2.


###


**Will there be a Hazbin Hotel crossover in Season 3?**


#


Yes. Helluva Boss Season 3 Part 1 only includes visual nods and easter eggs to Hazbin Hotel, while Part 2 in 2027 includes a small but direct crossover with the Hazbin Hotel cast, more than a cameo. Helluva Boss and Hazbin Hotel share the Hellaverse, along with characters like the Seven Deadly Sins and Vassago.
